One table of every plugin, theme and core version on every server, and one bulk run over the selection.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Manage**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/wp/inventory`

One row per component with its per-site rows, updates and severities.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?kind=plugin|theme|core&filter=updates,vulnerable,inactive,closed&q=&serverId=&siteSlug=&includeStopped=`
- **Returns:** `{rows[], fleet, feed, scanJob}`

### `POST /api/wp/bulk`

Run one action over many sites as a batch - one job per site.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{action, targets: [{siteSlug, kind, slug?}], backupFirst?: false, healthCheck?: true}`
- **Returns:** `202 {batch, jobs[], skipped[]}`

### `GET /api/wp/batches`

Recent bulk runs with rolled-up job counts.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?limit=10`

### `GET /api/wp/batches/:id`

One batch and all of its jobs - one poll drives a progress table.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{batch, jobs}`

### `POST /api/wp/scan`

Refresh the whole fleet snapshot.

- **Level:** Manage
- **Notes:** Job
